[[File:ThugBoss-JediPowerBattles.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Thug boss]]

The '''thug boss''', along with other [[Coruscant mercenary|Coruscant mercenaries]], were hired in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to prevent two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from reaching their [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. They were unable to [[Skirmish at Coruscant|defeat]] the Jedi, and the thug boss was killed in combat against the Jedi.<ref name="JPB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The thug boss appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]''.<ref name="JPB" />
